newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar mixed, scale sellers sighted.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar mixed, scale sellers sighted.

text.p: White sugar futures were reluctant to stray too far from the day's tight ranges as scale-up sellers moved in to cap the recent gains racked up on the spot October contract, traders said on Thursday.
The market's modest volume, which totalled 1,257 lots by 1530 GMT, was dominated by October but also sprinkled with against actuals and crossed trades.
October was down 50 cents at $327.50 and December unchanged at $322.00. Other traded contracts were tightly mixed and rangebound.
"It's nothing spectacular," said one trader, adding that arbitrage activity had also been subdued as the performance on the New York raws market was also subdued.
The Paris market was also quiet with just 216 lots posted on the board and movements tight.
October was up 20 cents at $327.20 and December unchanged at $322.00.
